title: Risk of Syncopal Relapses in Patients Treated With Permanent Pacing for Bradyarrhythmic Syncope
brief_summary: Prospective, multicenter, observational registry designed to collect data on syncopal relapses in patients undergoing pacemaker implantation for bradyarrhythmic syncope.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients undergoing pacemaker implantation for bradyarrhythmic syncope

Exclusion Criteria:

* age \<18 years
study_population: Consecutive patients undergoing pacemaker implantation for bradyarrhythmic syncope (proven or presumed) according current guidelines
